A practical response is: Test representative groups and expand with monitored stop criteria. The relevant concept is: Why use staged rollouts for system configuration? Limit impact and observe behavior before wider deployment. I would record the initial evidence, make the smallest scoped change needed, and compare the same measurements afterward. I would not assume that a successful change on one idle host proves fleet-wide safety.
